description: Evyasys delivery pipeline commands. Every command starts with `Evya` so they work in any agent runtime that supports slash commands — no namespace required.

commands.name: EvyaCreateStory
commands.description: Draft a complete user story from project context and (on approval) push it to Azure DevOps + Teams.

commands.name: EvyaCreateSubtask
commands.description: Break a story into developer-ready subtasks. Requires StoryID.

commands.name: EvyaStartDev
commands.description: Kick off development for a story: branch/PR checklist, set ADO state to In Progress.

commands.name: EvyaFinishDev
commands.description: Complete development: TDD review, merge checklist, transition to Ready for QA.

commands.name: EvyaStartQa
commands.description: Generate test plan/cases and transition the story to In QA.

commands.name: EvyaFinishQa
commands.description: Validate QA pass, prepare release notes, transition the story to Done.
